name: explore-sort-trade-game
description: Monorepo for the explore → sort/refine → trade/hub loop (WRECKLINE / Athanor / BASE HUB), plus invade/restore scaffolds.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @estg/shared && npm run typecheck -w @estg/explore && npm run typecheck -w @estg/sort && npm run typecheck -w @estg/trade && npm run typecheck -w @estg/invade && npm run typecheck -w @estg/restore
scripts.test: npm run test -w @estg/shared && npm run test -w @estg/explore && npm run test -w @estg/sort && npm run test -w @estg/trade && npm run test -w @estg/invade && npm run test -w @estg/restore
